text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt satisfying, but realizing a gain alone does not tell me whether the trade helped my overall portfolio.","I should make buy and sell decisions based on future prospects and portfolio needs, not on whether an individual holding is above or below its average cost.","My account has fluctuated over these periods, and with unpredictable prices I should not treat short-term moves as a dependable pattern or reason to trade more often."]}
